exposure: Prior vaginal birth after caesarean section
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
cohort: 243 women with previous cesarean delivery at public hospitals of Ambo town in 2019 (81 cases with successful vaginal birth, 162 controls).
finding: Parity of 3-4, labour monitoring with partograph, prior vaginal birth after cesarean section, duration of labour after admission less than 8 hours, and artificial rupture of membrane were significantly associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
